test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following pairs of "players from one team on court – sports" is correct?

I. 5 – basketball

II. 9 – handball
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only I**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Basketball**

 
 
• The International Basketball Federation (FIBA) was founded in **1932**.
 
• The current president of FIBA is** ****Sheikh Saud Ali Al Thani**.
 
• Basketball is the most popular sport in the **United States**. 
 
 
 
• **Handball **
 
 
• Handball was founded in 1917 by** Max Heiser**, **Karl Schelenz**, and** Erich Konigh**. 
 
• **Handball** has** ****7 members** per side.
 
• The International Handball Federation (IHF) was founded in **1928**.
 
• Handball, usually involves two teams of **seven **players each (including goalkeeper) pass a ball using their hands with the aim of throwing it into the goal of the opposing team. 
 
• The current president of the International Handball Federation is **Dr. Hassan Moustafa**.
